messages:
sana: Quick Q for product+eng — end-of-quarter goals snapshot. Can each owner drop a one-line: shipped / slipped / next step / blocker? Need rollup by EOD Fri. Ping: @eli @david @mira
sana: TL;DR: we want a concise status for the Q2 OKR doc, plus any cross-team deps. No long threads please, put links when relevant.
eli: shipped: runtime-v2 canary -> deployed to eu-west + us-west, perf targets met on 1k-user sim. CRs mostly merged; one perf test flaky. blocker: quota for dedicated GPUs for extended canary. Filed a quota request. PRs: https://gh/redwood/runtime/pull/483
mira: slipped: embeddings infra migration delayed — compatibility tests failing for quantized 2.1 models. root cause looks like KV cache mismatch on compacted checkpoints. plan: scope down to live inference pathway, postpone internal refactor to next sprint. next step: pair with research on test matrix; ETA ~2 weeks.
david: shipped: routing-policy defaults rollout (no-api-change). slipped: v3 autoscale tuning — observed flapping during burst windows. plan: add hysteresis + cap growth rate, run load test. need product decision: tolerate brief latency spike vs strict tail-lat SLO.
ops-bot: quota request submitted: INC-1234 (dedicated-gpu pool). ETA for review: 24–48h.
sana: thanks — can each owner paste their one-liner into the rollup doc (link below) in the next 2 hours? I’ll assemble for leadership. Link: https://docs.redwood/q2-rollup
david: added one-liner to doc. Also note cross-dep: embeddings migration blocks runtime cache refactor (mira + eli).
eli: CR pings: two open PRs that touch model-compat (#483, #499). @mira can you take a quick pass on the compat test changes?
mira: on it, will review both by EOD.
sana: if anyone expects slip >2 weeks, flag it here. Otherwise I’ll mark items as on-track/slipped in the rollup. :thumbsup:
eli: small ask — can product sign off on temporary canary quota increase for week-of cutover? saves ~3 days rollback time.
sana: noted, I’ll get sign-off today.
david: adding a short note about autoscale tradeoffs so product can choose.
sana: perfect — thanks all. I’ll close the rollup by 17:00 PT and ping execs.
